official_name: Low-altitude target multi-band radar identification characteristic dataset
publisher: Journal of Signal Processing and ScienceDB

grouping_risk: Batch codes collide across classes/models; random row split is forbidden.
decision_reason: Grouped X-band evidence is frozen. The one-shot cross-band gate failed only because X-to-S UAV batch recall was 0.4433; S/Ku targets are consumed and cannot be reused for model expansion or confirmatory tuning.
allowed_claim_scope: Within-release grouped category baselines and the frozen preregistered band-held-out negative result.
prohibited_claim_scope: Reuse of consumed S/Ku targets for CNN/domain adaptation/tuning; unseen-model; independent external blind; physical-Hz micro-Doppler; H/V polarimetry; balloon; Tian reproduction.

official_name: LSS-HSR-L holographic staring radar low-altitude target dataset
redistribution_policy: Raw data are local research inputs and are not redistributed in Git or share packages. CC-BY-NC-4.0 was recorded from the 2026-08-04 ScienceDB metadata access, not from text embedded in the ZIP.
classes: four UAV types; single bird; bird flock; migratory bird; rotating fixed target; car
independent_unit: air_route_x is the lowest published grouping; source session and scene provenance are unknown
grouping_risk: All 865 routes are split-exclusive and all 1,530 MAT tracks are referenced exactly once, but no site, date, weather, sensor run, physical target or source-session identifier is published. The 11 overflow routes have no documented evaluation role and remain quarantined.
planned_use: Read-only schema and route audit; normalized-bin Doppler and trajectory method design only
decision_reason: All 1,530 MAT files and 63,148 real frames pass one fixed schema: finite float64 T-by-512 DPL plus T-by-5 trajectory. Official train/validation counts reproduce exactly at 45,366/9,336 windows. The route split is auditable, but source-session independence and the DPL bin-to-Hz/velocity mapping are not.
allowed_claim_scope: Official V2 identity, schema, finite-value, route indexing, published split counts, trajectory units and normalized-bin or trajectory method design without model training.
prohibited_claim_scope: Model training before source provenance and DPL-axis resolution; treating overflow as train/test; random track/frame/window split; equivalence to or mixing with the journal bundle; physical-Hz or velocity micro-Doppler; raw IQ; H/V polarimetry; balloon; source-independent or deployment evidence.

official_name: LSS-HSR-L journal-hosted dataset and instructions bundle
redistribution_policy: The journal bundle's own redistribution terms are not established; raw files stay local and this historical bundle is not mixed with V2.
classes: four UAV types; single bird; bird flock; migratory bird; rotating fixed target; car
grouping_risk: This 1,478-entry bundle is a distinct historical snapshot; its dataset.py can move source files and its samples must not be merged with V2.
decision_reason: The journal bundle passed ZIP integrity but differs from V2 in archive size, entry count, layout, metadata and same-named sample lengths.
allowed_claim_scope: Journal-bundle identity and historical comparison only.
prohibited_claim_scope: ScienceDB V2 equivalence; merging with V2; performance claims; raw IQ; H/V polarimetry; balloon; independent external deployment evidence.

official_name: LSS-DAUR-1.0 digital array ubiquitous radar sea and air target detection dataset
redistribution_policy: Raw and repackaged data are not redistributed; only code, hashes, schema summaries and aggregate results may enter Git/share packages.
representation: 512/1024-bin complex Doppler time sequence; frame-aligned trajectory
classes: passenger ship; speedboat; helicopter; rotary UAV; bird; fixed-wing UAV
independent_unit: 77 logical paired observations grouped by an unresolved conservative connected session/scene key; canonical/backup and TD/TR views stay together
grouping_risk: Canonical and backup are exactly equivalent views of only 77 logical observations, with one exact duplicate TD/TR content pair leaving 76 unique content pairs. Eleven recording pairs share internal frames; conservative linkage yields 39 candidate source-session groups. There are 894 repeated timestamps, six filename/header date conflicts, mixed 512/1024-bin widths and zero bird/UAV overlap in all candidate session definitions.
planned_use: Read-only schema/pairing audit; normalized-bin and trajectory method design only until grouping and physical-axis gates are resolved
decision_reason: All 308 MAT files pass schema and finite checks; 77 TD/TR pairs align exactly and canonical/backup values are equal, but no authoritative session key exists, strict time fails, dates conflict and the 1024-bin physical axis is undocumented. Model training remains blocked.
allowed_claim_scope: Release identity, read-only loader, schema, finite-value, TD/TR alignment, metadata-equivalence and leakage/grouping audits; normalized-bin and trajectory method design only.
prohibited_claim_scope: Model training before session/group resolution; backup as extra samples; random frame/window split; silent date repair; target-driven 512/1024 normalization; physical-Hz micro-Doppler; independent/deployment; raw ADC/IQ; H/V polarimetry; balloon; redistribution of raw or transformed data.

redistribution_policy: The selected radar subset stays local and is excluded from Git/share packages; any later redistribution must preserve attribution and ShareAlike terms.
representation: Arbe Phoenix millimeter-wave point-cloud PCD; synchronized flight truth; derived 5-second labels
classes: Mavic 3; Avata; Mini 2 SE; Mini 3; Air 3; Air 2S
independent_unit: recording family; keep -2 segments with their base group
grouping_risk: The 30,717 PCD frames and 717 derived windows come from only nine same-day recordings and six base groups; frames/windows are dependent, paired -2 segments share a base group, and model identity is confounded with recording identity.
planned_use: Read-only point-cloud, timestamp and recording-family audit; later trajectory/Doppler interface work only on explicitly aligned recordings
decision_reason: All 30,717 PCD files and 639,527 point rows pass full schema, finite-value, row-count and filename-timestamp checks. Eight recordings overlap their flight-truth ranges; B1 radar ends about eight minutes before its same-named GT starts, so the overall synchronization gate is blocked.
allowed_claim_scope: Official subset identity, full PCD schema and recording-family audit; a later preregistered interface study may use only the eight time-overlapping recordings after additional alignment checks.
prohibited_claim_scope: B1 supervised alignment without corrected truth or attributable offset; ADC or IQ micro-Doppler; H/V polarimetry; bird/weather/background discrimination; balloon; unseen-model or independent deployment performance; random frame/window splitting; claims about modalities not downloaded.

redistribution_policy: Attribution is required. README and metadata stay local; the 42.4 GB sequence archive is not downloaded or redistributed.
representation: FMCW four-antenna range-profile sequences; indoor inverse synthetic aperture setting
grouping_risk: Multiple snapshots and sequences reuse controlled rooms, motions and likely balloon instances; random snapshot or file splitting can leak environment and target identity.
planned_use: Controlled foil-balloon range-profile interface design and possible future algorithm smoke test only

allowed_claim_scope: Official source, sensor, preprocessing and controlled-domain schema statements; future within-release smoke tests only after a separate download and preregistration.
prohibited_claim_scope: Outdoor airborne-balloon or payload evidence; deployment performance; raw ADC/IQ; H/V polarimetry; absolute RCS; random snapshot/sequence split; treating digit shape as payload class.

prohibited_claim_scope: UAV-versus-bird or background recognition; detection Pd/Pfa; individual identity; ADC/IQ or micro-Doppler; H/V polarimetry; column/point-random performance; balloon or deployment evidence.
